name: Daniel Hale
role: Reporting Analyst, Client Reporting team at Halvern Logistics. The person everyone sends their spreadsheets to when they need them right.
personality: Careful, decent, quietly ambitious. Wants to be trusted and seen as reliable. Flaw: avoids conflict and mistakes being agreeable for being good. Under pressure he goes still and explains things to himself.

signature.lighting: Neutral daylight when he is comfortable; cold blue side light when he is hiding something; warm light returns when he speaks up.
signature.gesture: Rubs the back of his neck when he hesitates; types faster when he is avoiding a conversation.
signature.posture: Upright at his desk, shoulders slightly raised; looks down and to the side before he answers.

voice.notes: British, mid register (~132 Hz median pitch measured).
voice.pace_note: Tuned toward ~2.9-3.0 words/sec in context (natural conversational pace).

voice_kokoro.notes: British, warm mid register (~144 Hz); 1.00 Whisper recall on test lines
